entities.name: Fort Keff
entities.description: A settlement near the Eye of Ugin on Akoum, Zendikar.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought at Fort Keff and left to seek help on Ravnica.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker Gideon had unsuccessfully searched for.

entities.name: Surrakar
entities.description: A beast that warned of gods from beyond the world and later led the fort's inhabitants to underground rivers.

entities.name: Eldrazi brood
entities.description: Swarming creatures that attacked the fort.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan who darkened the skies over the fort.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers Gideon presumably sought out.

events.summary: A primal scream from a surrakar wakes the fort's inhabitants, including Gideon, who had come seeking rest after searching for Chandra.
events.quote: A primal scream tore the sleep from the inhabitants of the fort, including planeswalker Gideon Jura .

events.summary: The surrakar warns of gods from the void with no color who would devour all life.
events.quote: The beast warned Gideon and the assembled soldiers of its gods who came from beyond the world

events.summary: The brood swarms the fort; Gideon fights bravely and alone turns the tide.
events.quote: he alone turned the tide against the brood

events.summary: Emrakul darkens the skies and Gideon tells everyone to follow the surrakar to the underground rivers and flee.
events.quote: Gideon told all the inhabitants of the fort to follow the surrakar to the underground rivers and flee.

events.summary: Gideon sets out for Ravnica to petition a group of planeswalkers for help.
events.quote: Gideon set out for Ravnica to petition the help of a group of planeswalkers he had heard rumors about

relations.quote: Fort Keff is a settlement near the Eye of Ugin on the continent of Akoum on Zendikar .
Gideon fought bravely amongst the soldiers of Fort Keff
